responsibility: Implements GCC’s generic spelling-suggestion algorithm for strings. This file provides the case-aware restricted Damerau-Levenshtein edit-distance computation, the heuristic cutoff for deciding whether a candidate is meaningfully close enough to suggest, and the closest-candidate search over string vectors via the best_match framework, serving as the reusable backend for diagnostics that offer typo suggestions across GCC subsystems.
same_name_distinction: Provides the spellcheck implementation and selftests behind the interfaces declared in gcc/spellcheck.h. Unlike the header, this .c file contains the concrete restricted Damerau-Levenshtein algorithm, suggestion cutoff/search logic, and CHECKING_P test routines rather than the reusable API, traits, and best_match template definitions.
